High level: we can absolutely run a 60-minute technical demo + 30-minute optional follow-up deep-dive for security/network. To keep it fair across time zones, we typically run a 3-week rotating cadence: Week A (Americas-friendly), Week B (EMEA-friendly), Week C (APAC-friendly). Below are proposed slot options (pick 1 per region), I can do the scheduling once you confirm who needs to be in the recurring placeholder.

Proposed rotating slots (pick preferred option per region):
- Americas (Week A): 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET — good for product + SRE in the US
- EMEA (Week B): 4:00 PM CET / 11:00 AM ET — good for compliance + platform in EU
- APAC (Week C): 9:30 AM SGT / 2:30 AM PT (we'll rotate so APAC gets a morning slot)

If those look OK I can set up a recurring 3-week placeholder that alternates these slots and invite your folks. For immediate availability, here's my booking link: https://calendly.com/aditya-redwood/demo-30m — feel free to pick a concrete date and I'll convert into the rotating cadence.

Attached: Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (short agenda + asks). I've also attached a one-page SLA overview we usually send ahead of infra/security.

If you prefer certain team members only on the APAC/EMEA weeks (e.g., security only on EMEA/US weeks), please flag and we'll make those invites optional.
